item.title: Moundville Lithic Arts Festival brings awareness about Native American culture, practices
item.description: As 79-year-old Carl Bryant grabbed his knees pads and a pressure flaker, he was not only prepared to carve arrowheads, but also to teach community members through a live flint knapping display at the Moundville Lithic Arts Festival on Friday. item.title: Prescribed fires cause haze over campus
item.description: Twice last week, smoke from prescribed burns in the Oakmulgee Division of the Talladega National Forest blew from central Alabama into Tuscaloosa as unexpected wind shifts and a high‑pressure system trapped haze over campus during the height of burn season. item.description: The City of Tuscaloosa announced on Friday that University Boulevard will be closed to through traffic between Redmont Drive and Arcadia Place from Saturday, March 14 at 8:30 a.m. until Sunday, March 22 at 5 p.m. The closure aligns with the University’s spring break. item.description: Two new independent student magazines will publish their first print editions next month, the culmination of a campaign to continue publications that The University of Alabama shut down Dec. 1.
